whyItMatters: An unknown or absent licence class leaves the redistribution question unanswered, which matters for every packaged build. This rule reads an application that declares no licence for what it ships.
actions: Record the licence class the project actually ships under, or stop depending on the component until it is known. Specifically: fix an application that declares no licence for what it ships.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm mix.exs no longer carries an application that declares no licence for what it ships.
